title: Sequencing: product rollout
bodyMd:
Five product features are released in sequence, one per release window. Every feature is released exactly once.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Alerts, Billing, Chat, Dashboard, Export.

- Billing must precede Export.
- Alerts must be immediately followed by Dashboard.
- Chat and Export must not occupy consecutive positions.
